body.x: GOYANG, Korea (AVING Special Report on 'KES 2006') -- <Visual News> Haier Korea presented an AC/heater MRV series at KES 2006. The series will be launched into Korea market in 2007. The MRV series is a split-system air conditioning and heater with free-standing portable units. The outdoor units come in small and different sizes, thus easy to move in high-rise apartment elevators according to the company. It is also said that with 4-way air exchanging technology compressors and condensers operate with high efficiency in heat exchange.
